verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents extensive API/Terraform parity for core resources (CKS clusters, node pools, Inference API, Object Storage credentials, billing export via FOCUS API), supporting strong API-driven workflows. However, several capabilities are explicitly described as Cloud-Console-only (Capacity Finder for Spot Node Pool placement, viewing quotas, browsing/uploading objects via console) with no documented API equivalent, showing the UI and API are not fully at parity. Missing for 10: explicit API equivalents for Capacity Finder, quota viewing/requesting, and independent confirmation that all console workflows are API-reachable.
